component.description: TAPPaaS module openwebui: triage of its own critical/high CVEs (#788).

analysis.detail: Debian/Ubuntu packaging bug (Lua loaded as a dynamic library); nixpkgs builds redis with its bundled Lua, and this redis listens on 127.0.0.1:6379 only.
Concerns an unofficial Windows port of Redis (dbghelp.dll search path); upstream Redis on Linux is not affected.

is_pem_format misses some PEM forms in mixed HMAC/asymmetric setups; Open WebUI signs and verifies its own session tokens with HS256 and its own WEBUI_SECRET_KEY (algorithms=['HS256'] fixed); the only keyed decode of foreign tokens (OIDC back-channel logout) allows RS*/ES* only with key objects from Authentik's JWKS.

Code injection through the Chroma server's /api/v2 collections endpoint; Open WebUI uses chromadb as an embedded PersistentClient inside its own process; no Chroma HTTP server runs (verified: the only listener in the container is uvicorn on 8080).

Heap overflow during multi-threaded AV1 encoding; nothing in the container encodes AV1 (Open WebUI's ffmpeg only writes WAV and MP3).
D-Bus introspection XML parsing; GLib is loaded only by ffprobe/ffmpeg through librsvg/cairo/pango, which never parse D-Bus introspection data (no D-Bus in the container).

mbedtls_x509_string_to_names use-after-free; libmbedcrypto7 is in the image only for librist4: the only user in the image is librist4, ffmpeg's rist:// network protocol; Open WebUI hands ffmpeg local files, and nested protocols from a file input are limited to file,crypto,data, so RIST is never opened.

SSRF via the url argument of unstructured partition(); Open WebUI's UnstructuredLoader always passes a local file path, never url.
Overflow in MiniZip; Debian's zlib1g does not contain MiniZip (that is libminizip1, not installed).
Empty-k oct key in a trusted JWKS; the only JWKS PyJWT parses is Authentik's (back-channel logout), which publishes no oct keys, and that decode allows only RS*/ES* so an HMAC key is never used.
PyJWKClient redirect handling; Open WebUI never uses PyJWKClient (it fetches the JWKS through Authlib), and the only other user, google.oauth2.id_token, is not configured.
